name: FREEZE
pitch: Freeze trouble and win Chapters with sturdy winter creatures.

name: ICE PALACE
pitch: Preserve terrain and landmarks, then score a huge late Chapter.

name: SPARKS
pitch: Charge tiles and deal quick burst damage.

name: STORM ENGINE
pitch: Build Charged setup, draw into payoff cards, then explode in one turn.

name: HEAL & GROW
pitch: Heal your Heart and make a big friendly board.

name: LIVING KINGDOM
pitch: Use landmarks, Overgrown terrain and Wonder to win without racing damage.

name: DRAGONS
pitch: Pressure the Heart and finish with dragons.

name: ASH ECONOMY
pitch: Burn your own terrain or creatures when destruction creates more value.

name: FLOW
pitch: Wet tiles, draw cards and move around blockers.

name: WEATHER CONTROL
pitch: Turn Wet into recipes and keep changing where the fight happens.

name: BUILD
pitch: Fortify tiles and build landmarks for Realm Score.

name: WALKING CITY
pitch: Use huge creatures and structures that turn the board into a fortress.

name: MOVE
pitch: Reposition creatures and sneak through gaps.

name: SKY ROADS
pitch: Use movement triggers and floating terrain to make impossible routes.

name: SPOOKY FRIENDS
pitch: Play cute ghosts and bring fallen friends back.

name: LANTERN LOOP
pitch: Sacrifice creatures for value, recur them, and grind out later Chapters.

name: AURORA MACHINE
pitch: Freeze + Charge the same tiles, discover Aurora Ice, then cash in the setup.

name: ASHBLOOM
pitch: Grow your own realm, burn it on purpose, and turn loss into explosive new terrain.

name: STEAM DRAGONS
pitch: Burn + Wet tiles into Steamfield and use the chaos to support dragons.

name: STORMGLASS
pitch: Wet + Charge the board, draw quickly and create storm-combo turns.

name: SECOND SPRING
pitch: Let friendly creatures die, bring them back, and turn Haunted+Overgrown into value.

name: FLOATING KINGDOM
pitch: Fortify + Windsweep land into floating terrain, then build a strange moving city.

name: GHOSTWATER
pitch: Use Wet+Haunted terrain, recursion and repositioning to outlast both Chapters.

name: MELTHEART
pitch: Deliberately mix opposite elements, creating Meltwater and tempo swings instead of choosing one side.
